checks: Core matcher verifies repeated mode and active unconsumed exact ticket without filesystem/cache mutation.
Unrelated or old ticket cannot set, consume or clear a newer active proposal fence.
Only repeated mode changes broker state; default and mapped-span@1 callback paths return unchanged.
Transport resets request/response for each channel before parsing, invokes completion hook even on malformed/failed exchange, and stops session if hook itself raises.
Transport is single-threaded for requests: next accepted edit is processed after completion hook.
Read-only working source retrieval remains available for inspection after blocked edit outcome.
New transport owner is explicitly included in selected runtime source archive closure.
limits: This is source inspection; owner is separately running core/client/socket and Docker qualification.
Successful kernel send is not proof of client receipt/decoding; unknown client outcome remains no-automatic-retry with inspection.
No provider call, live benchmark, Docker launch, new proof, or token-savings claim made by this review.

resolved_finding.original: Surrounding broker checks or send failures could occur after repeated core cleared the successful proposal.
resolved_finding.resolution: Owner authenticates request, recognizes active matching ticket without source reads, blocks edits before context, and clears only for same request and proposal when confirmed page send completes. Pre/post context or send failure remains blocked.
